institution: IIT Delhi (Indian Institute of Technology Delhi)
description: Automated solar-powered electrodialysis reversal (EDR) unit with IoT continuous fluoride telemetry and automated acid-wash cycling for zero resin fouling.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: The proposed EDR technology is technically superior for fluoride removal but is physically impossible to fabricate, calibrate, and install within the 7-day SLA for a ₹45,000 budget. Authorities should reject this for immediate deployment but consider it for long-term R&D, as the current timeline and cost constraints make it non-viable for urgent village-level relief.

The solution is technically infeasible and nonsensical, as it proposes a 'lost person search' for a problem described as 'disturbances' caused by known individuals, failing to address the root cause of social conflict. Authorities should reject this pilot due to the lack of technical substance, logical inconsistency, and inability to provide any tangible relief or safety measures.

description: Installation of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) corrugated double-wall culvert pipes with concrete headwalls and permeable gravel soakway embankment. Can be installed in 5 days.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: The solution is technically robust and cost-effective, directly addressing the hydraulic capacity deficit with standard, durable materials. It is highly recommended for immediate pilot deployment as it ensures long-term reliability and rapid restoration of school access within the SLA.

description: Deployment of an activated-alumina bio-sand filter with low-cost indigenous electrodialysis reversal (EDR). Features automated backwashing powered by a small 200W solar panel and IoT TDS/Fluoride level telemetry sent to the Gram Panchayat WhatsApp bot.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: Exceptional low-cost design. Direct resolution of fluoride scaling issue with IoT monitoring meets high standards for sustainable village-level adoption.

description: Replace dead RO membranes with low-pressure composite nanofiltration membranes, coupled with a rainwater harvesting percolation pit to recharge the local aquifer with low-mineral water.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: Viable engineering approach, though higher initial capital expenditure and membrane import costs.

description: Modular pre-cast concrete box culvert installation using locally available M30 mix and geo-textile reinforced approach slopes. Can be assembled within 6 days with minimal traffic stoppage, providing 40-tonne load capacity.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: Rapid deployment precast modularity satisfies the 15-day Mandal SLA with high structural resilience against monsoon scouring.

description: Phase Change Material (PCM) thermal-buffer hybrid solar ILR with supercapacitors and GSM temperature alarm. Keeps vaccines safe at 2-8°C for up to 72 hours even under zero sunlight and zero grid power.

aiEvaluation.aiRemarks: Masterclass solution for rural healthcare infrastructure. 72-hour zero-power holdover completely neutralizes cold-chain failure risks.
